## b4a9c10b7b20

**Reproduced distribution/validator defect: lawful aligned marker pairs are excluded.** Generator SHA-256 `0df078a417887ba984994433a43c6ed5e852f46a0fc72b4ca24ef5ff28103340`; executed rule hash `9f058f737a77`.

The canonical rule draws the bounding rectangle border for every color appearing exactly twice. It does not require the two markers to differ in both row and column: an aligned pair becomes a one-cell-thick line. The generator and `self_check` instead require distinct rows *and* distinct columns, so the plausible rival **ignore aligned pairs** fits every generated example.

`checks/audit/b4a9c10b7b20/input.json` is an exact 7×9 witness. Color 2 occurs at `(1,1)` and `(1,5)` on the same row; color 3 forms an ordinary diagonal pair at `(3,2)` and `(5,4)`. The supported Racket apply command produced a color-2 line across row 1, columns 1–5, while `self_check` returned `color 2 pair shares row 1 (degenerate rect)`. The rival omits that line and differs at exactly those five cells.

Full input, authoritative output, rival output, differing cells, domain result, source hashes, and command are retained in `checks/audit/b4a9c10b7b20/witness.json`; the independent authority report is `checks/audit/b4a9c10b7b20/racket.json`. This target was not modified.
